title: Lemon Blueberry Yogurt Loaf Cake
description: A moist loaf cake made with Greek yogurt, lemon zest and juice, and studded with fresh blueberries.
ingredients: finely grated zest and juice of 1 unwaxed lemon
steps: Whisk together yogurt, eggs, sugar, vanilla extract, lemon zest and juice.
Fold flour through; stir in blueberries.
Scrape into a 900g (2lb) loaf tin lined with parchment; bake on middle shelf 45 minutes until risen and light golden.
notes: Try orange zest & juice with raspberries as an alternative. Stays moist 3–5 days.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
